note: finals_mesh_sched.json plus the two windows that RAISE a speed. Harness (8 seeds x 12 laps per cell): 96/0 at 0.098 s, median lap 12.645 against the baseline's 12.910 and the safe schedule's 12.710; 96/0 at 0.058 s, 12.235 against 12.460. It keeps min clearance above the baseline's (0.103 vs 0.075 at 0.098, 0.075 vs 0.025 at 0.058) and improves the s 19 entry cut, but it takes 0.034 m off the hairpin's own clearance (0.214 -> 0.180 at 0.098), and both extra windows took a collision at 0.058 s before c37_entry was added. It is a speed-gaining change and therefore owes Gate C (100 Xvfb laps) and Gate D (32 display laps) in its own right; the harness ranks arms but does not predict which period fails.

windows.note: The e_free/k_e cross-track speed cut is the only _speed_plan term that binds on this track, and on the hairpin EXIT it clips at v_mod_min while the car is already 0.5-0.9 m/s under plan.
